# sherpa-transfer-list

A two-pane shuttle (available ↔ selected). Pool comes from populate([{ value, label, selected? }]); `selected` picks the pane.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | Transfer List |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-transfer-list/sherpa-transfer-list.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-transfer-list/sherpa-transfer-list.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-transfer-list/sherpa-transfer-list.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-transfer-list/sherpa-transfer-list.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-transfer-list/sherpa-transfer-list.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-transfer-list data-source-heading="Available columns" data-target-heading="Shown columns"></sherpa-transfer-list>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-transfer-list`:

```json
[
  {
    "value": "name",
    "label": "Name",
    "selected": true
  },
  {
    "value": "plan",
    "label": "Plan"
  },
  {
    "value": "seats",
    "label": "Seats"
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-source-heading` | text | `Available` | heading for the available pane |
| `data-target-heading` | text | `Selected` | heading for the selected pane |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | disabled state — no move is made |
| `name` | text, native |  | the form field its selected values are submitted under |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selected` | `string[]` | read and write |  |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `formResetCallback()` | A form reset puts back its first selection. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `transfer-change` | `{ direction: 'add' \| 'remove'; moved: string[]; selected: string[] }` |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`empty`, `heading`, `list`, `moves`, `pane`, `panes`
